remedies.description: Make interactive controls keyboard accessible with correct focus order and visible focus indicators.
Give form fields accessible labels and clear error messages for screen reader users.
Increase text foreground and background contrast so low vision readers can read text.

reports.text: I cannot reach the checkout button by pressing Tab on my keyboard.
The email field has no label announced by my screen reader.
The pale grey price text on white is very hard to read with low vision.
There is no visible focus outline when I navigate the payment controls using the keyboard.
